language.description: The language of the app she reads in, as a short code ('en'). The one attached picture is a screenshot of the Audible app's now-playing screen, taken when she stopped listening to an audio Bible.

set_off_from.description: The chapter she began listening at, by name ('Leviticus 1', 'Romans 8'): where the screenshot's chapter most likely is, at or after it. Only a hint for a chapter line that names no book; the picture decides.
